title: Rinova BD — Admin Dashboard
tagline: The back office of a working beauty shop
description: The admin dashboard behind Rinova BD: orders and their delivery pipeline, catalogue and stock, customers, returns and reviews, offers, staff roles, POS and barcode printing, and the analytics panel — the screens the owner actually runs the shop from.
highlights: Opens straight into the dashboard — no sign-in for reviewers
Order pipeline across every status, with courier state
Catalogue with cost, margin and restock thresholds
POS, barcode labels, offers, staff roles and returns
All figures are fictional demo data, not a live shop

credentials.label: No password needed
credentials.note: This copy runs on static demo data with its backend disconnected. Nothing you click changes anything, and no real customer information is present.
